answer: Start from the failure: one operator behind many keys. Require personhood credentials cross-signed by two independent issuers reading different signals, one document and one live challenge. A duplicate forfeits the credential, so a cloned bundle loses its value on first reuse. Auditors rotate, so no issuer is bought twice. Each pass through the forge costs two bribes, and at the vertex of the funnel one plume of fakes must survive both issuers at once.
